plugins.description: living-plan: write a phased living plan. manager: run it to completion, one phase per PR, with fresh implementer and independent exact-SHA reviewer subagents, a braked fix loop and batched owner decisions. create-vault: a project knowledge vault the implementers keep current. manager-retro: improve the skill from recorded runs, through a reviewed PR.
